## Summary

Field descriptions in horizontal fields do not receive the intended `text-balance` styling. `FieldRoot` renders `data-orientation="horizontal"`, but `FIELD_DESCRIPTION` uses `group-has-data-horizontal/field`, which looks for a `data-horizontal` attribute.

## Proposed fix

In `components/ui/field.py`, match the parent field’s orientation value, e.g. replace `group-has-data-horizontal/field:text-balance` with `group-has-data-[orientation=horizontal]/field:text-balance`.

## Acceptance criteria

- A horizontal `FieldRoot` causes its `FieldDescription` to receive `text-balance`.
- A vertical `FieldRoot` does not receive the horizontal-only `text-balance` styling.
- Add a focused regression check for the selector and verify both orientations visually.

## Evidence

`FieldRoot.create` sets `data-orientation` from its `orientation` prop. The codebase already uses value-matching group variants such as `group-has-data-[size=lg]/avatar-group`.

# Detail Bug Report

https://app.detail.dev/org_d38a878f-9df9-4c4b-a96a-f5180b860085/bugs/bug_758f9e17-ccb8-43ef-a68f-bfa110f17c93

Introduced in [#81](https://github.com/elviskahoro/buridan-ui/pull/81) by @LineIndent on Jun 14, 2026

# Summary
- **Context**: `components/ui/field.py` defines the Reflex/Tailwind v4 `field` components; `FieldDescription` renders helper text inside a `field.root`, and its CSS class is supposed to opt into balanced text wrapping when the wrapping field is laid out horizontally.
- **Bug**: The `FIELD_DESCRIPTION` class uses the Tailwind selector `group-has-data-horizontal/field:text-balance`, but no element in the app ever emits a `data-horizontal` attribute (`FieldRoot` actually emits `data-orientation="horizontal"`), so `text-balance` is never applied.
- **Actual vs. expected**: Expected — per the docs, "Helper text slot that automatically line-balances lengthy strings cleanly when utilized inside horizontal configurations." Actual — `text-balance` is dead weight on `FIELD_DESCRIPTION`; descriptions never line-balance, even inside a `field.root(orientation="horizontal")`.
- **Impact**: A documented behavioral feature silently never takes effect. It is exercised by shipped examples — e.g. `app/www/library/examples/switch_description.py` and `app/www/library/examples/checkbox_description.py` place a wrapping-length description inside a horizontal `field.root` — so the missing `text-wrap: balance` is observable in the demo app, not a hypothetical edge case.

# Code with Bug
`components/ui/field.py`:
```python
FIELD_DESCRIPTION = "text-left text-sm leading-normal font-normal text-muted-foreground group-has-data-horizontal/field:text-balance [[data-variant=legend]+&]:-mt-1.5 last:mt-0 nth-last-2:-mt-1 [&>a]:underline [&>a]:underline-offset-4 [&>a:hover]:text-primary"
#                                                                                               ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ <-- BUG 🔴 selector can never match: looks for [data-horizontal] via group-has
```

`components/ui/field.py` (attribute actually emitted by the group/root):
```python
orientation = props.pop("orientation", "vertical")
props["data-orientation"] = orientation   # <-- root has data-orientation="horizontal", never data-horizontal
```

# Explanation
Tailwind compiles `group-has-data-horizontal/field:text-balance` into a selector that requires a `.group/field` element to `:has([data-horizontal])` somewhere under it. This can never be true because:
- The field root uses `data-orientation="horizontal"`, not an attribute named `data-horizontal`.
- The attribute is on the group/root element itself, but `group-has-...` checks for a *descendant* attribute; the needed relationship is `group-data-[orientation=horizontal]/field:...`.

As a result, `text-wrap: balance` is never applied to field descriptions in horizontal layouts.

## Codebase Inconsistency
Other orientation-aware components use the pattern `group-data-[orientation=horizontal]/<group>:...` (e.g. `components/ui/tabs.py`, `components/ui/timeline.py`, `components/ui/toggle_group.py`), making `field.py` an outlier.

# Recommended Fix
In `components/ui/field.py`, change the selector token to match `FieldRoot`’s `data-orientation` attribute and the established variant pattern:
```python
FIELD_DESCRIPTION = "text-left text-sm leading-normal font-normal text-muted-foreground group-data-[orientation=horizontal]/field:text-balance [[data-variant=legend]+&]:-mt-1.5 last:mt-0 nth-last-2:-mt-1 [&>a]:underline [&>a]:underline-offset-4 [&>a:hover]:text-primary"
```
Also update the doc mirror in `assets/docs/components/field.md` to keep it in sync.

# History
This bug was introduced in commit 7d27209a. Commit `7d27209` created `components/ui/field.py` and included the broken `group-has-data-horizontal/field:text-balance` token while the same commit already emitted `data-orientation` on `FieldRoot`.

fix(field): match FieldDescription selector to data-orientation attribute

FIELD_DESCRIPTION used group-has-data-horizontal/field:text-balance,
which looks for a descendant with a data-horizontal attribute that is
never emitted. FieldRoot sets data-orientation on the group/field
element itself, so the correct selector is
group-data-[orientation=horizontal]/field:text-balance, matching the
pattern already used in tabs.py, timeline.py, and toggle_group.py.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
